**Answer**

The combined height of the two tallest men on the 2022‑23 Lehman College roster was **13 ft 2 in** (6 ft 7 in + 6 ft 5 in).  
The combined height of the two tallest men on the 2023‑24 roster was **13 ft 4 in** (6 ft 7 in + 6 ft 7 in).

So the 2023‑24 team’s tallest pair is taller overall.

---

### How the numbers were obtained

| Season | Tallest player(s) | Height | Source |
|--------|-------------------|--------|---------|
| 2022‑23 | 1. Kai Parris (or another player at 6‑7) | 6 ft 7 in | `Lehman College 2022‑23 Men's Basketball Roster` – “F 6'7" 180 lbs … So.Bronx, NY Riverdale Kingsbridge Academy” |
| 2022‑23 | 2. Kevin B. or similar (6 ft 5) | 6 ft 5 in | Same roster – “F 6'5" 205 lbs … So.Bronx, NY Murray Hill Academy” |
| 2023‑24 | 1. Ebenezer Asmah | 6 ft 7 in | `Lehman College 2023‑24 Men's Basketball Roster` – “C 6'7" 190 lbs … Fr.Bronx, NY University Prep Charter” |
| 2023‑24 | 2. Kai Parris | 6 ft 7 in | Same roster – “F 6'7" 185 lbs … Jr.Bronx, NY Riverdale Kingsbridge Academy” |

*Combined heights*  
- 2022‑23: 6 ft 7 in + 6 ft 5 in = 13 ft 2 in.  
- 2023‑24: 6 ft 7 in + 6 ft 7 in = 13 ft 4 in.

Thus, the 2023‑24 Lehman College men's basketball team’s tallest two players together are taller than the pair from the 2022‑23 season.

NEW YORK (Jan. 9, 2024) ---Kai Parris of Lehman Collegehas been named Divisions II/III Men’s Player of the Week by the Met Basketball Writers Association.
The designation, for games played Jan. 1-7, is unique in that it encompasses players from 48 Met area schools across Divisions II and III.
A 6-7 junior forward from the Bronx, NY, Parris --- who also was named CUNY Athletic Conference player of the week --- averaged 20.5 points, 10.0 rebounds and drilled 17 3-point goals as the Lightning (7-6) defeated CCNY 79-70 at home on Wednesday and edged Brooklyn 70-67 on the road Friday in a pair of league matchups.
Parris posted a double-double with 20 points and 11 rebounds in the win over CCNY.
He concluded the week against Brooklyn with 21 team-high points on 8-of-9 shooting from the floor while adding nine rebounds and three assists.
